summary: All five final/source comparison views and full opposite checked. Repaired dark windshield stays continuous with slim wipers; yellow cargo/cab, silver trim, four wheels, rails and rear doors remain intact. Wheel rims and some edges show expected low-poly faceting versus the high source, without large panel damage. Fresh GLB/FBX technical validation passes at 14332 triangles, and all 1485 windshield rays in each format retain front coverage close to the measured surface.
